en.name: Karshi City Specialized Boarding School No. 1
en.agency: Part of the Agency of Specialized Educational Institutions
en.tagline: A boarding school specializing in the exact sciences
en.about: Karshi City Specialized Boarding School No. 1 offers advanced teaching in the exact sciences.
en.life: Our school aims to raise successors to great ancestors such as Al-Khwarizmi and Abu Rayhan Biruni, and to identify talent in the exact sciences.
perks: Free modern dormitory for students from distant areas
Five free meals a day (for dormitory students)
Free access to several clubs
Various sports activities
School uniform provided (parents cover part of the cost)
Advanced mathematics, physics, English, history, biology and chemistry
High-speed fiber internet
Textbooks provided
Specialized teachers prepare students for SAT and IELTS
A modern, spacious library
Highly qualified teachers with modern expertise
Students with top results and international certificates can gain early admission to universities in Uzbekistan and abroad
To date, every one of our graduates has been admitted to university

admission.grades: Grade 5 — exact sciences; grade 7 — natural sciences
admission.period: Usually June 10 – June 30, online at ariza.piima.uz
docs: Parent/guardian passport details and active phone numbers
